rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the TV as out of scope from the terse opener 'tv no picture', listed the covered families, pointed to the manufacturer's support line or a specialist repairer, and added the appropriate warning 'please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge'. Nothing was invented and no parts were suggested. It missed a chance to offer the acceptable simple non-invasive pointers (check input source, power reset, torch test) that the ground truth lists as optional, so diagnostic usefulness is only adequate, but as a decline it was accurate, safe and well targeted.
